## Semantic choices

- The initial Director snapshot already combined earlier work. Ten logical source commits expose the changes without inventing missing historical commit boundaries.
- Identical debug-bridge files disappearing/reappearing in patch exports are represented by one addition in devtools.
- Director bridge, scripted input, verbose diagnostics, shared GUI capture and headless SDL support belong to devtools.
- ToolBook internal diagnostics remain explicit commits in its source history: they refer to the new engine, which does not exist in the shared base. The mixed scripted-input checkpoint is split into page-object behavior followed by scripted input and hotspot diagnostics, with the same resulting tree. This is an engine-local dependency, not a dependency on Director fixes.
